BOREALISCARDS2-METRICS_FTUE_PROMPT.body:
Would you like to anonymously share gameplay data to help improve Borealis Cards 2's balance?

Collected data includes run results, Ascension, card choices, your final deck and relics, encounters, and event or shop choices.

No Steam account information, account name, or persistent player identifier is collected.

You can change this setting later in Mod Settings.
BOREALISCARDS2-METRICS_FTUE_ENABLED.head: Gameplay Data Enabled
BOREALISCARDS2-METRICS_FTUE_ENABLED.body:
Thank you! Anonymous run data will be shared to help with balance analysis.

You can disable this at any time in Mod Settings.
BOREALISCARDS2-METRICS_FTUE_DISABLED.bod:
Gameplay data will not be shared.

You can enable this later in Mod Settings.
